punchlist.hotkey.comment.punchListFilter:
Toggles the PunchList filter on/off.
While on, only Schematic Verifier-selected mismatch
positions are rendered, and the schematic ray trace
passes through everything else.
punchlist.config.comment.enclosedMode:
Enclosed-block layer for the PunchList filter.
show: layer off.
hide: hide positions invisible in the finished build,
including faces onto sealed pockets; leaves also occlude
other leaves.
hide_strict: only vanilla opaque full cubes occlude
(pocket fill still applies).
punchlist.config.comment.followPlayerDis:
Re-center the verifier's closest-N marker window on the
player after moving this many blocks. 0 disables (stock
behavior: window anchors to the last block change or GUI
interaction). Default 32.
punchlist.config.comment.pocketFill:
Also hide punchlist positions whose exposed faces only open
into sealed interior pockets (air spaces with no path to the
outside of the build). Uses an exterior flood fill over the
schematic's intended states; leaves and glass count as
see-through. Off restores plain 6-neighbor enclosure.
punchlist.config.comment.pocketFillMaxVo:
Skip the pocket flood fill when the build's bounding volume
exceeds this many blocks (memory/compute guard). Enclosure
then runs without pocket detection.
punchlist.config.comment.enclosedSoftOcc:
Soft-occluder classes for hide mode.
Entries: '#namespace:tag' or 'namespace:block'.
Soft occluders hide only blocks of their own class,
and only while shaped as full cubes.
punchlist.gui.button.hover.enclosed:
Enclosed blocks
§7Hide positions that are invisible in the finished build.
§eShow§r  layer off
§eHide§r  also sealed pockets, leaves hide only leaves
§eHide (strict)§r  opaque full cubes only
